summary: 53-year-old man fell near Ouzel Falls in the Wild Basin area and suffered numerous traumatic injuries; a trail crew was on scene within 30 min and a park medic provided advanced life support; 20 rangers/trail crew plus 7 Rocky Mountain Rescue volunteers brought him down through deep snow on a rescue toboggan and wheeled litter; ambulanced to Estes Park Medical Center
location: Ouzel Falls, Wild Basin, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers/trail crew; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: Incident date pinned to Thu 2011-06-02: report filed Mon Jun 6 says the fall was reported "last Thursday afternoon". Weekday-verified.
